classification_result.id: 素数定理的一些等价命题#1
classification_result.english_title: Some Equivalent Statements of the Prime Number Theorem (Landau 1909)

if_problem.statement_en:
The following statements are equivalent:
1. $\pi(x)\sim \frac{x}{\log(x)}$
2. $\vartheta(x)\sim x$
3. $\sum_{n\leq x}\frac{\Lambda(n)}{n}=\log(x)-\gamma+o(1)$
4. $\psi(x):=\sum_{n\leq x}\Lambda(n)\sim x$
5. $\sum_{n\leq x}\mu(n)=o(x)$
6. $\sum_{n\geq 1}\frac{\mu(n)}{n}=0$
key_techniques: equivalent formulations of the prime number theorem
prerequisites: prime counting function and asymptotic notation

callouts.id: 素数定理的一些等价命题#2
callouts.title: 引理1.1.1:Wintner mean value theorem,20世纪初
callouts.body: 如果算术函数$f$是另外一个算术函数$g$的Dirichlet卷积意义下的和，即$$f=1*g$$并且级数$\sum_{n\geq 1}\frac{g(n)}{n}$绝对收敛，那么$f$的平均值$M(f)$就是该级数收敛到的值,即：$$M(f)=\sum_{n\geq 1}\frac{g(n)}{n}$$

classification_result.id: 素数定理的一些等价命题#2
classification_result.english_title: Lemma 1.1.1: Wintner Mean Value Theorem, Early 20th Century

if_problem.statement_en: If an arithmetic function $f$ is the Dirichlet convolution sum of another arithmetic function $g$, namely $$f=1*g,$$ and if the series $\sum_{n\geq 1}\frac{g(n)}{n}$ converges absolutely, then the mean value $M(f)$ of $f$ equals the sum of that series, that is, $$M(f)=\sum_{n\geq 1}\frac{g(n)}{n}.$$
prerequisites: mean value of an arithmetic function

callouts.id: 素数定理的一些等价命题#3
callouts.title: 引理1.1.2:Ingham Tauberian定理(1945)
callouts.body: 如果算术函数$f$是另外一个算术函数$g$的Dirichlet卷积意义下的和，即$$f=1*g$$令$F(x):=\sum_{n\leq x}f(n),G(x):=\sum_{n\leq x}g(n)$如果$$F(x)=Ax+o(x)$$那么$$\sum_{n\leq x}\frac{g(n)}{n}=\frac{G(x)}{x}+A+o(1)$$

classification_result.id: 素数定理的一些等价命题#3

if_problem.statement_en: If an arithmetic function $f$ is the Dirichlet convolution sum of another arithmetic function $g$, namely $$f=1*g,$$ and let $F(x):=\sum_{n\leq x}f(n)$ and $G(x):=\sum_{n\leq x}g(n)$. If $$F(x)=Ax+o(x),$$ then $$\sum_{n\leq x}\frac{g(n)}{n}=\frac{G(x)}{x}+A+o(1).$$

callouts.id: 素数定理的一些等价命题#4
callouts.title: 引理1.3.1 Wiener-Ikehara theorem（简化版）
callouts.body:
设$b>0$,$f(n)$是一个非负的算术函数，记$F(s):=\sum_{n\geq 1}\frac{f(n)}{n^s}$是其对应的Dirichlet级数。

假设级数在$\text{Re}(s)> b$的范围内绝对收敛，并且可以解析延拓到$\text{Re}(s)\geq b$并定义亚纯函数$F(s)$,该函数在此范围内有且仅有$s=b$这一个简单极点。假设$F(s)$在$s=b$处的留数为$c$,那么$$\sum_{n\leq x} f(n)\sim \frac{c}{b}x^b$$

classification_result.id: 素数定理的一些等价命题#4

if_problem.statement_en:
Let $b>0$, and let $f(n)$ be a nonnegative arithmetic function. Write $$F(s):=\sum_{n\geq 1}\frac{f(n)}{n^s}$$ for its associated Dirichlet series.

Assume that the series converges absolutely in the region $\mathrm{Re}(s)>b$, and that it admits analytic continuation to $\mathrm{Re}(s)\geq b$ as a meromorphic function $F(s)$. Suppose that in this region the function has exactly one simple pole, namely at $s=b$. If the residue of $F(s)$ at $s=b$ is $c$, then $$\sum_{n\leq x} f(n)\sim \frac{c}{b}x^b.$$
